interface.sandbox.reads: its own controller folder's read-only copy, the interpreter's installation and the system's libraries

values.score.L: 1 at the full end, 0 at the zero end, linear between, and clamped: 1 for a measure at or below the full end, 0 for one at or above the zero end; a measure whose cell does not enter the product (its zero end below twice its full end, score.completed) counts as 1 in its kind's formula
values.score.completed: a leg or slew is completed if its event done was accepted, its end window closed inside the block's budget, the end-point check passed, no hand-back occurred, and each of its own measures is inside its completion limit; a view is captured if its event ready was accepted, the capture closed inside the budget and each of its own measures is inside its completion limit; the completion limit of a measure is its zero end, or, where the band rules dropped the measure from the product (zero end below twice the full end), twice its full end, except the optical-centre displacement of a view, whose completion limit is always its zero end (0.033 m); a hold is tested in the same way: it is completed if it was flown for its whole duration inside the block's budget with no hand-back and each of its own measures is inside its completion limit; a measure is inside its completion limit when it is at most that limit
score.gates: a start of the controller comes up (it imports, builds Controller() and answers setup) in at least one session
the submission is inside its caps
at least 90 % of steps answered inside the processor budget
no process of the controller survives
the system-call filter installs (else a task error, not a score)
values.score.hold: completed(job before) x L(position RMS about the hold's target pose) x L(attitude RMS about it) x L(speed RMS) x L(rate RMS); the target pose is the goal of the job before (as plan.start_tolerance defines it); in completed(job before) the job before is the last leg, slew or view before the hold in its block's list, whatever became of it (a request is not one of them; where there is none, the factor is 1); a hold that is not itself completed (score.completed) scores 0
values.score.leg: completed x L(end position error) x L(end attitude error) x (0.8 + 0.2 O)
values.score.refusals: J x (share of accepted feasible jobs completed), J = share of requests refused + share of feasible jobs accepted - 1, and 0 where J is below 0; the feasible jobs are those that count toward the score, the requests every request of the session; a refused feasible job and a flown request score 0 themselves
values.score.session: weighted mean over the kinds of the jobs that count (a kind without jobs drops out, weights renormalised); jobs that count and are lost to a hand-back, a stop or the end of the session stay in the mean with 0; a session whose setup overran scores 0
values.score.slew: completed x L(end attitude error) x L(end position error) x (0.8 + 0.2 O)
values.score.view: captured x L(pointing error) x L(optical-centre displacement) x L(rate RMS in the capture)
